text: accounts: no length cap on email/password/device_label; reject ':' in email addresses

Done in fe527d5. Email capped at 254, NOT the 320 you proposed - see the ticket body for the RFC reasoning. Deciding factor: invites.MAX_INVITED_EMAIL_LENGTH is 254, so a 320 cap would have allowed accounts that mint() can never invite. A test now asserts MAX_EMAIL_LENGTH <= MAX_INVITED_EMAIL_LENGTH so the two cannot drift apart again. Password 320 as you asked, device_label 128. Colon rejection folded in here since it is the same function; change-email inherits all of it.
